definitions.explanation: A device that cools or heats and conditions indoor air.

examples.english: To turn on the air conditioner.

examples.japanese: エアコンの{温度|おんど}を{下|さ}げる。
examples.english: To lower the air conditioner temperature.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}いからエアコンを{強|つよ}くした。
examples.english: It's hot, so I turned up the AC.

examples.japanese: {寝|ね}る{前|まえ}にエアコンのタイマーをセットする。
examples.english: I set the air conditioner timer before going to bed.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}はエアコンなしでは{過|す}ごせない。
examples.english: In summer, I can't get by without air conditioning.

notes:
エアコン is an abbreviation of エアコンディショナー (air conditioner). In Japan, most units provide both cooling and heating.

COMMON OPERATIONS:
- エアコンをつける / {入|い}れる: to turn on the AC
- エアコンを{消|け}す / {切|き}る: to turn off the AC
- {温度|おんど}を{上|あ}げる/{下|さ}げる: to raise/lower the temperature

MODES:
- {冷房|れいぼう}: cooling
- {暖房|だんぼう}: heating
- {除湿|じょしつ}: dehumidify
- {送風|そうふう}: fan only

USAGE:
Essential in Japanese summers. Many homes and offices rely on エアコン as the primary climate control. {省|しょう}エネ (energy-saving) settings are widely promoted. The abbreviated form エアコン is far more common than the full エアコンディショナー.
